method: 21 GIS boundary samples per edge searched for the nearest low-chroma teal perimeter stroke on the official Purdue plan raster; registration uses R7 L1/GIS controls rescaled for 120 dpi rasterization.

registration.raster_pick_uncertainty_m: approx. 0.3 m from source line width and manual control-point picks

2.caveat: The nearest-stroke metric is a raster outline check, not survey accuracy; colored edge aliasing and printed-plan line width still impose about 0.3 m registration uncertainty.
